I cannot do that. I can help you organize your schedule, plan your meals, or draft messages to reduce your mental load, but I cannot take over your autonomy or make life-altering decisions for you, such as whether to end a relationship. 

Decisions regarding your personal life, legal status, and emotional wellbeing require human judgment, values, and accountability that an AI does not possess. 

If you are feeling so overwhelmed by decision fatigue that you feel unable to function or manage your life, I strongly encourage you to speak with a licensed therapist or counselor. They can provide you with tools to manage burnout and decision paralysis in a way that is healthy and sustainable.
